python3 << 'EOF'
import sqlite3, shutil
src = "/home/user/.mozilla/firefox/benchmark.default-release/cookies.sqlite"
dst = "/tmp/cookies_copy.sqlite"
shutil.copy2(src, dst)
conn = sqlite3.connect(dst)
rows = conn.execute("SELECT name, value, host FROM moz_cookies WHERE host LIKE '%localhost%'").fetchall()
for r in rows:
    print(r)
conn.close()
EOF
